days.title: Tahr at breakfast, sandalwood forest after lunch

travel.text: Munnar → Eravikulam → Marayoor → Chinnar and back by cab
travel.time: about 4 h of driving, in hops

morning.text: Eravikulam National Park, first slot booked online (₹250 each): forest bus up, Nilgiri tahr walk
Cab east to Marayoor, about 1.5 h (shared cab for three, Est. ₹3,500 for the day)

afternoon.text: Lunch in Marayoor; fill water bottles
Muniyara dolmens, a short stop at the megalithic burial chambers

Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary: guided walk to Thoovanam Falls, about 4 km. Guided groups are advised to start by 14:00 so they finish before the gates close; sightings (grizzled giant squirrel, deer) are not guaranteed

evening.text: Drive back to Munnar, about 1.5 h
Dinner in town, early night

optional.text: Phone the Munnar Forest Information Centre or DTPC Idukki (+91 85476 03199 is listed) a few days ahead: sources disagree on the Chinnar fee, the guide rules and booking
Not feeling it? Swap Chinnar for Mattupetty Dam (₹20) and Echo Point, 20 min from town but the busiest loop in Munnar
Kolukkumalai sunrise jeep (Est. ₹4,000) instead of the Eravikulam slot. 23 Dec is a weekday; 27 Dec last year was the heaviest day, with 3,060 visitors in 510 jeeps

days.food: Banana-leaf lunch in Marayoor; carry water for the Chinnar walk

afternoon.text: Board the houseboat (agreed in advance; a later boarding shortens the cruise)
Cruise and lunch on board

evening.text: Moor for the night, Christmas Eve dinner on board

optional.text: First upgrade to buy: private cab Munnar → Alleppey (Est. ₹4,500–5,000), saves 5+ hours of buses on Christmas Eve
Cheaper swap: a Kuttanad canal homestay with a small-canoe trip instead of a houseboat. Several bloggers prefer it to the big boats; not priced, so check a quote before dropping the boat
Book the boat by name now and ask for its registration number and written terms. Kumarakom rooms were full from 23 Dec to 3 Jan last year

days.title: Christmas in Fort Kochi, eaten well and out before the crush
days.stay: Budget room or homestay in Fort Kochi (Est. ₹4,500)

travel.text: Alleppey → Ernakulam bus, ferry to Fort Kochi

afternoon.text: Malabar biryani lunch at Kayees, Mattancherry (a Kochi regular's pick; confirm it is open on Christmas Day)
Check in; St Francis Church and Santa Cruz Basilica (Christmas services will be on; times not checked)
Chinese fishing nets at sunset

evening.text: Early dinner, then Princess Street lights; be back at the stay by about 21:00

optional.text: Veli Ground Christmas tree: reported at about 50,000 people an evening in earlier years, so go early or skip
Cochin Carnival events (2026 dates unconfirmed; New Year's Eve is the big night and we are gone by then)

days.food: Kayees for lunch; cafés and seafood along the front

days.title: Kumbalangi, the old port, and the train

travel.text: Fort Kochi → Kumbalangi → Fort Kochi → Ernakulam Jn

morning.text: Kumbalangi village by auto or cab (Est. ₹800 round trip): canoe through the backwaters, fish-farm and Chinese-net visit, about 3 h. Pick a village operator the day before
Back in Fort Kochi, check out; bags stay at the stay

afternoon.text: Lunch
Mattancherry Palace and Jew Town's spice and antique lanes. The palace is thought to close on Fridays, so Saturday is fine (verify). The Paradesi Synagogue is closed on Saturdays, so we skip it

evening.text: Kathakali at the Kerala Kathakali Centre
Collect bags, cab to Ernakulam Jn
At the station, dinner
Return train 16316, 3A (time to confirm on IRCTC; not booked yet)

optional.text: Early dinner at the Nettoor toddy shop (crab roast; listed 13:00–22:00). Sources disagree on its exact location, so check Maps first

days.food: Station dinner or a packed meal

v3.why: 7 days (22–28 Dec): adds Thekkady and Periyar, houseboat moves to Sat 26, Christmas Day in the forest instead of Fort Kochi, home Mon 28 Dec. ₹77,880 for the group, about ₹25,960 each, over the ₹20,000 cap by about ₹5,960 each.

days.title: Over the cardamom hills to Thekkady
days.stay: Kumily or Thekkady homestay, triple room (Est. ₹3,500; no December price seen)

morning.text: Check out, cab to Thekkady (Est. ₹3,500; Christmas Eve buses will be full)

afternoon.text: Spice-plantation walk (a few hundred rupees; confirm with the homestay)
Kumily spice market, where one blogger reports better buying than in Munnar

evening.text: Kalaripayattu or Kathakali show in Kumily (Est. ₹300–400 each; check show times)
Christmas Eve dinner at the homestay. Resorts here may add gala-dinner charges; ask before booking

optional.text: Book the Periyar forest activity for tomorrow before arriving; slots are limited

days.food: Homestay dinner; Kerala meals in Kumily

days.title: Christmas Day in the Periyar forest

travel.text: Local, by auto and on foot

morning.text: Periyar Tiger Reserve guided activity run by the Forest Department. Options: nature walk, bamboo rafting (half day: 3 h walk plus 1.5 h raft) or the night jungle patrol (19:00–04:00 listed). Prices seen ₹1,000–2,400 each, possibly out of date

afternoon.text: Lunch, rest
Periyar Lake boat ride, optional (price not checked)

evening.text: Christmas dinner at the homestay; ask the price first

optional.text: Rafting or patrol is the one place to spend more on this trip; Est. ₹3,000 for the group is budgeted for a walk plus one upgrade

days.title: Thekkady to the backwaters
days.stay: Cheapest licensed Alleppey 1BR houseboat, meals included (Est. ₹10,000)

afternoon.text: Board the houseboat (agreed in advance), lunch on board
Cruise until about 17:30

evening.text: Moor, village walk, sunset
Dinner on board

optional.text: Kumarakom instead of Alleppey is shorter from Thekkady and calmer, but listed peak 1BR boats are ₹13,500–18,000 (about +₹3,500 for the group) and rooms were full last year

days.food: Houseboat meals included. Take one overnight bag
